brief: Diya, Nursery (about 3.5 years). Prefers gu-IN. Speaks only Gujarati at home; wants to hear things twice.

target: Picked ગુજરાતી Lovely poems and stories
મારી શાળા My School Gujarati Grade 3-4 S

detail: Nursery child landed on a 'Grade 3-4' text, made for children who already read.
On the reading page nothing was said out loud, and the written instructions (English) are not something this child can read.
Wanted to hear the poem first but could not tell which button does that.
Buddy talked for over 12 s in one go before the child could read.
Wanted Buddy to read the line again, but there is no button for that while reading ('Listen first' is switched off during a session).
Buddy started talking 1.7 s into a planned 3.77 s thinking pause.
Tapped the big microphone to talk; the session paused instead.
Buddy started talking 2.5 s into a planned 3.27 s thinking pause.
